payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear framework for evaluating models in the human-machine communication game, focusing on efficiency and accuracy through specific metrics.

claims.text: Models are evaluated based on the efficiency of the communication scheme, quantified by the retention rate of tokens, and the accuracy, measured by the fraction of sentences that match the target sentence.
The evaluation involves optimizing a communication scheme to balance the tradeoff between efficiency (using fewer keywords) and accuracy (high probability of reconstructing the target sentence).
Multi-objective optimization approaches are used to achieve desirable tradeoffs between efficiency and accuracy, leading to more stable and effective communication schemes.
